directory.description: Top-level directory for domains. Default: /var/lib/gnupg/wks (see gpg-wks-server(1) OPTIONS --directory).

from.description: Default sender address for all outgoing WKS service mails (see --from option).

headers.description: List of custom headers to add to all outgoing WKS service mails. Each item must contain 'name' and 'value'. (see --header option).

domains.description: List of configured domains. Each entry must define at least the domain name, and optionally its submission address (stored in domain/submission-address file).

procmail_recipe.description: Optional example procmail recipe for redirecting submission addresses to gpg-wks-server. Not active config, but useful for documentation (see EXAMPLES in gpg-wks-server(1)).
